title: contracts/navigation.json
description: The app's route table for navigation-and-routing's check-navigation.mjs. Paths are repo-relative. With Expo Router a route id is the route file's path under the routes folder without its extension ('(app)/tasks/[taskId]'); with React Navigation's static API it is the screen name ('TaskDetail').

router.description: Which router the app uses. The checker applies that router's rules.

home.description: The first screen: an href with Expo Router ('/'), a screen name with React Navigation ('Home'). Going back to it is dismissTo/popTo or back, never navigate or push.

routes.description: Every route of the app, exactly once. Expo Router: every route file under the routes folder except _layout, +html, +native-intent, +middleware and +api files, platform variants counted once. React Navigation: every screen of the root static config (top-level screens and group screens).

protected.description: Expo Router: every Stack.Protected (or Tabs.Protected) group the navigator files render. `file` is the repo path of the file that writes the group (a layout, or a component a layout renders such as src/features/root-navigator/app-stack.tsx); `guard` is the text of the guard expression ('isSignedIn', '!isSignedIn'); `screens` are the `name`s of every Screen inside the group, nested groups included.

groups.description: React Navigation static API: the groups of the root static config, in order (the first group whose if hook is true gives the initial screen), each with its `if` hook and screens in order.

guarded.description: Routes whose screen holds unsaved or in-progress work. `hook` is the repo path of the file that blocks removal with usePreventRemove (the feature's model hook, or a hook it imports). "gesture": "off" also turns the iOS back swipe off (gestureEnabled and fullScreenGestureEnabled false) for a screen where even starting the swipe is wrong (a live session, a canvas that pans sideways).

modals.description: Routes presented modally: their Screen options set presentation (modal, formSheet, pageSheet, fullScreenModal, transparentModal, containedModal or containedTransparentModal).

paramParsers.description: Expo Router: every route with a dynamic segment ([taskId], [...rest]) mapped to the repo path of the file that parses its params with valibot.

debugRoutes.description: Test-build routes. Expo Router: route ids; each renders through TEST_ONLY and sits in a protected group. React Navigation: { route, file } with the file of the component that renders TEST_ONLY; the screen sits in a group with an if hook.

placeholders.description: Routes that render the placeholder screen while their real screen is not built yet. check-navigation --release fails while any is left.

jsStack.description: true allows the JavaScript stack (expo-router/js-stack, @react-navigation/stack). Default false: the native stack.

navigatorFile.description: React Navigation: the root static config (default src/features/root-navigator/root-stack.tsx).

containerFile.description: React Navigation: the only file that calls createStaticNavigation (default src/features/root-navigator/navigation-root.tsx).

typesFile.description: React Navigation: the global RootParamList declaration (default src/features/root-navigator/react-navigation.d.ts).

paramsFile.description: React Navigation: the route params types (default src/features/root-navigator/route-params.ts).
